answer: Reputation-weight escrow. Each identity’s influence is capped by a slowly maturing escrow funded from its own past earnings, so a wallet that acts like a fresh nebula of clones stays near-zero weight until real activity accumulates. Any cluster flagged by shared timing or funding triggers a beacon that freezes the operator’s entire escrow pool, not just the flagged wallet. An attacker must therefore sustain each identity through a long, costly warm-up (roughly 0.4% of volume per month in foregone liquidity), and a single sable trace voids the whole operation’s capital.
